name: Sparse Voxel Octree Construction (Queue-Based Collapse)
aliases: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) Builder with Queue-Based Collapse
definition: An algorithm to construct a Sparse Voxel Octree from a stream of indexed leaves. It uses a fixed-size array of queues to manage nodes at different tree levels, collapsing homogeneous subtrees into single leaf nodes or invalid nodes to compress the tree structure.
